---
title: Parser and LLM
---

## How they fit together

SearchAgent separates model transport from model format:

1. The parser converts SearchAgent messages into the model's expected format.
2. The LLM client sends that payload to a provider or inference server.
3. The parser converts the response back into an assistant message and tool calls.

This separation lets one endpoint serve models with different chat templates, and lets
one parser work with any compatible provider.

## Parser

A parser owns message formatting and tool-call decoding. It does not make network
requests. Built-in parser types are:

| Type | Use case |
| --- | --- |
| `upstream` | Provider-native tool calls, such as OpenAI-compatible APIs |
| `tongyi_deep_research` | Tongyi DeepResearch text-format tool calls using `<tool_call>` tags |
| `websailor` | WebSailor prompt assembly and text-format tool calls |

`Parser.to_model()` prepares the message history. `Parser.from_model()` yields
provider-independent assistant messages. Parsers that set `uses_provider_tools` also
receive OpenAI-style tool schemas through the provider request.

```yaml
agent:
  parser:
    type: upstream
```

For Tongyi DeepResearch:

```yaml
agent:
  parser:
    type: tongyi_deep_research
```

For a custom parser, subclass `searchagent.llm.parsers.Parser` and configure its
import path:

```yaml
agent:
  parser:
    type: custom
    target: pkg://my_project.parsers:MyParser
```

To define and configure your own parser, see
[Custom parser](../04-developement/01-development.qmd#custom-parser) in the
development guide.

## LLM client

An LLM client owns API communication, request concurrency, usage data, and endpoint
selection. It receives already formatted messages and returns the provider response.
Built-in client types include `openai` and `anthropic`; optional providers require their corresponding dependency.

```yaml
agent:
  llm_client:
    type: openai
    model: Qwen3-8B
    default_kwargs:
      temperature: 0.6
      top_p: 0.95
    openai:
      api_key: EMPTY
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1
      concurrency_limit: 128
```

`default_kwargs` are included in every completion request. Provider-specific settings
belong under the matching provider key, such as `openai` or `anthropic`.

To add and use your own model provider, see
[Custom LLM client](../04-developement/01-development.qmd#custom-llm-client) in
the development guide.

## Retry policy

Parsing failures are recoverable when another generation may produce valid output.
Configure them explicitly:

```yaml
agent:
  llm_retry_config:
    max_tries: 5
    exceptions:
      - pkg://searchagent.llm.parsers:ParsingError
```

Only list errors that are safe to retry. Authentication errors, invalid model names,
and other permanent configuration failures should surface immediately.
